spec_case: issue #503 (transport, a config-default adapter whose host refuses the connection)
description: A config-default lmstudio pointed at a closed port, retries: {max_attempts: 2, backoff_ms: 1}, on_error: continue: curl exit 7 (connection refused) is retryable, so both attempts run and retries_used is 1; curl's own stderr clause there is masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md), not pinned by this case.
